CustomField.description: True when the termination of this contract can still be undone: status Terminated or Closed, termination date filled and less than 7 days ago, termination method filled and not "Termination Reverted" (a termination without method, e.g. old contracts or the Subscription25 Terminate button, is not reverted by rbb_Contract). Used by the visibility of the Undo Termination action and by scr_Contract_Undo_Termination; the user check (cp_ContractUndoTermination or System Administrator) is done there.
CustomField.formula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Terminated"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed")), NOT(ISBLANK(Subscription25__Termination_Date__c)), TODAY() < Subscription25__Termination_Date__c + 7, NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Termination_Method__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Termination_Method__c, "Termination Reverted")) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The termination can still be undone (less than 7 days after the termination date).
CustomField.label: Undo Termination Allowed
